verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies automatic interaction capture. Replay Vision says it adds cues beyond what is 'captured by clicks and pageviews alone', rage clicks show up as product signals, and session replay records what real users do. No first-party doc states that clicks, pageviews or form interactions are autocaptured without code, and the AI wizard still writes custom event tracking code. Missing for 10: explicit autocapture documentation, evidence of form-interaction capture, confirmation that no per-event code is needed, independent corroboration.
